initial_helper: One indentation error was corrected before its native process launched.
initial_bake_wrapper: The first bake completed natively but the generic wrapper rejected its expected texture outputs. A constrained allowlist of only the twelve declared output paths now distinguishes bake output from input mutation; runtime checks remain strict.
neutral_capture: White capture clipped body shading; neutral-grey capture preserves the photographed shading for colour reconstruction.
publication: Stale publication and a refresh were rejected during concurrent Kart/Challenger/Garage edits. The second immediate refresh/bake/publish attempt passed its exact input fence. Generated livery preview pictures are excluded because stock/plain car construction does not consume them.
discarded_readiness: One retry started while the first stalled readiness process was still alive, changing its private test file. The mixed-input timeout and interrupted retry are rejected; later selected checks ran sequentially with stable input digests. Only owned test processes were stopped.
readiness_control: The old four-draw control later completed all assertions, with the same shutdown diagnostics. Therefore the discarded timeout is not claimed as a clean, deterministic regression failure. Canvas-only pages now skip the irrelevant 3D radiance preparation; real 3D views keep it.
shutdown: Some GL App/layout runs emit two ObjectDB / one resource-at-exit diagnostics. The before-photo control reproduces them with the old faceted view. Native photo and gallery tests exit cleanly; warning-bearing runs remain strict-cleanup gate failures despite passing their functional assertions.
fixture: The old unlit-roof hue expectation was replaced by an explicit light-roof/hood raster check matching the real, lit stock Rally. A render-drain experiment did not remove the App exit findings and was reverted. Engine display/version string normalization in the asset checker was corrected without changing its engine requirement.
